name: Helena
message: 「So, how have things been looking lately?」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, it doesn't seem like we're dealing with someone ordinary, after all...」

name: Helena
message: 「Really, I'm sorry for putting you all through so much trouble」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, there's no need to say that」

name: Helena
message: 「*Cough, cough*... If only this old body of mine were a bit stronger...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, come on, it's just a little playfulness. Don't retort so fiercely, now, n-o\s04」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come to think of it, where's Big Sis Melilot?」

name: Helena
message: 「One moment she's holed up in the library doing research, and the next she's walking all around the academy grounds」

name: Macaron
message: 「I wonder if there's anything I can help her with?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's fine. Just leave this part to Melilot」

name: Helena
message: 「You know how the saying goes--leave it to the experts, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「You two just focus on doing what you can do」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaa-geez! Arden, go team up with someone else, nya!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hopeless. He doesn't have the slightest clue how to court someone.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh~ Then by all means, we'd love some instruction from Professor Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh!? U-Um, t-today's a bad day for it, so maybe another time...」

name: Sally
message: 「Mako-chii said that pushy guys get hated!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, in Mr. Lion's case, I don't think it's possible for him to be disliked any more than he already is.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Arden, don't you ever get tired of doing this every day?」

name: Arden
message: 「As if I could ever get tired of loving Pasta-chan!」

name: Paqy
message: 「True, I never get tired of Ria-chan's boobs either.」

name: Arden
message: 「Still, why the hell aren't things going smoothly... Dammit!」

name: Arden
message: 「Hey Prez, how'd you manage to hit it off with the pint-sized Demon Lord anyway?」

name: Synn
message: 「Though, I guess I was thinking about Macaron.」

name: Arden
message: 「Hell yeah, me too! My head's always packed full of naughty fantasies about Pasta-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「How should I put it--I was thinking about what I'm capable of doing, I guess」

name: Synn
message: 「Like, wondering what I can do for Macaron's sake」

name: Synn
message: 「I think Macaron was probably thinking the exact same thing for me」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh... You're both just way too good-natured」

name: Arden
message: 「I should think about what I can do for Pasta-chan...」

name: Arden
message: 「I feel like I can do anything!」

name: Arden
message: 「Thanks, Prez! That really fired me up!」

name: Arden
message: 「Hey, hey, Pasta-chan, is there anything you want me to do for you?」

name: Pasta
message: 「W-What's gotten into you all of a sudden, nya? You're creeping me out even more than usual, nya...」

name: Arden
message: 「If there's anything I can do, I'll do whatever you want」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha... He probably just has a lot on his mind.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Talk about acting like it's someone else's problem.」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't mean it like that, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「I just felt something strange coming from over there...」

name: Synn
message: 「If I'm right, it should be this way...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord, let's be a little more careful here.」
Right after a flash of light burst before my eyes--
Seized by the illusion that my limbs had been torn apart, everything went limp.
My body collapsed straight forward onto the ground.

name: Macaron
message: 「Hang in there, Big Brother! I'll fix this right now!」

name: Paqy
message: 「This thing... it's a magic trap camouflaged with Spirit Power!」

name: Paqy
message: 「And the only one who can pull off something like this is...」

name: Soltia
message: 「How unfortunate. I was planning to take you both out at once, you know...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even with the great me around, that was careless...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ms. Soltia! Let go of my brother!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Any factor that obstructs Re-Crea must be eliminated without exception」

name: Azel
message: 「That is the will of the Lord」

name: Soltia
message: 「That's right. This angel is the very proxy of God who harbors this cycle's Re-Crea...」

name: Soltia
message: 「He is now the power of Re-Crea itself!」

name: Synn
message: 「No way... Azel is an angel... harboring Re-Crea...」

name: Macaron
message: 「So that's why I had a strange feeling...」

name: Azel
message: 「...Everything is the Lord's will. This is the mission bestowed upon me by the Lord.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have been waiting for this moment.」

name: Azel
message: 「All this time, for this very moment...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I see. So the missing expedition team was actually this guy...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Hehe... It seems you truly hadn't noticed.」

name: Soltia
message: 「I suppose going out of my way to infiltrate the academy and work so hard to cover it up was worth the effort, then.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Soltia, there is no need to explain any further.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Once we eliminate the Demon Lord right here, our long-cherished wish will be fulfilled...」

name: Soltia
message: 「The world will be reborn into a new form filled with light, and I will be able to be reincarnated as an angel!」

name: Soltia
message: 「I'll wipe you out right this instant.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I won't let you do that! I'll be your opponent!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Macaron... go call everyone... You can't do this alone...」

name: Macaron
message: 「No! There's no way I could just leave you behind, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because this time, it's my turn to fight for you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Taking on both of you might put me at a disadvantage, though...」
Macaron thrusts Alzard into the ground beside me, blocking the path between us and Soltia's group.

name: Soltia
message: 「Ah, I see. Are you intending it to be a shield to protect him?」

name: Macaron
message: 「It means my bare hands are more than enough! It wouldn't be any fun without at least this much of a handicap, right?」
To think she'd face someone like Soltia without Alzard...

name: Soltia
message: 「Kh... This much power without a medium...!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I can fight without clinging to Alzard!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because my big brother supports my heart... the me right now can fight!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm putting everything I've got into this!」

name: Macaron
message: 「When I get serious, I'm capable of way more than this!」
Macaron doesn't give an inch, trading blows with Soltia on completely equal footing.
She's even overcome her reliance on Alzard that much...
Before I knew it, she'd become so strong.

name: Azel
message: 「...Both you and this world shall return to nothingness」

name: Azel
message: 「That is the mission bestowed upon me by my master...」

name: Synn
message: 「What's the point of doing something like that!」

name: Azel
message: 「What sort of value is created or not is of no concern to me」

name: Azel
message: 「As my master's servant, I merely fulfill that mission」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you really okay with that, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「If you intend to get in my way, then I...」

name: Pasta
message: 「I won't let you do that, nya!」

name: Arden
message: 「If Pasta-chan says so, then I won't letcha either!」

name: Pasta
message: 「We can't let Bylous-nyama's rival die in such a cowardly way, nya!」

name: Arden
message: 「Doing it for Bylous ticks me off, but... if that's what Pasta-chan wants!」

name: Azel
message: 「What can the likes of you, who have been sneaking around in hiding until now, possibly do」

name: Pasta
message: 「S-Shut up, nya! I wasn't scared at all, nya!」

name: Arden
message: 「One or two angels are n-n-n-no big deal at all!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Anyway, for Bylous-nyama's sake, we're gonna protect the Demon Lord, nya!」

name: Azel
message: 「I shall purify the likes of you first」
With just a single blow unleashed by Azel, the two of them are sent flying.

name: Azel
message: 「The likes of you cannot even manage to lay a finger on me.」

name: Arden
message: 「We won't know that until we try...」
Swallowed by the light of Spirit Arts, their two silhouettes collapse.

name: Azel
message: 「In the end, that is the extent of your power.」

name: Pasta
message: 「T-That kind of strength is cheating, nya...」
If only my body could move freely...!
Then I could save my friends!

name: Pasta
message: 「Thinking about it now, we did something really stupid, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyau... I shouldn't have relied on an idiot like Arden, nya...」
Arden's back becomes a sturdy wall, taking the attack meant for Pasta.

name: Arden
message: 「I won't let you... lay a single finger on Pasta-chan!」

name: Arden
message: 「Not Bylous, who won't even come to help at a time like this」

name: Pasta
message: 「H-His idiocy has finally reached the terminal stage, nya...」

name: Azel
message: 「Then as you wish, I'll wipe you both out together!」

name: Pasta
message: 「A-Arden, stop doing something so stupid already, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Arden, that's enough, nya... Stop trying to act so cool, nya...」

name: Arden
message: 「At least at a time like this, let me look cool...」

name: Arden
message: 「It pisses me off, but I can't beat that bastard...」

name: Arden
message: 「Still, y'know, I can at least be your shield, Pasta-chan...」

name: Arden
message: 「This is everything I've got left in me!」
The outlaw's massive frame swells and roars with sheer fighting spirit.
Raising his last ounce of strength, the flame of his life blazes fiercely.

name: Pasta
message: 「You really are... a hopeless idiot, nya... *sniff*」
I slam an awakened, all-out blow straight into Azel!
In rapid succession, a second strike, a third!
Staggering back, Azel retreats deep into the twilight.
The expression on Arden's face as he collapses looks strangely satisfied, and.
Unable to call out to him any further...

name: Melilot
message: 「It took me a little longer than expected to break through the barrier...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thanks to Sakura-kun unleashing his power, we managed to make it work, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let's save the detailed explanation for later. More importantly, right now, Macaron-san--」

name: Soltia
message: 「You're better than I thought. Still, haven't you about reached your limit?」

name: Macaron
message: 「True, is what I'd like to say... but yeah, this might be bad...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Let's put an end to this little game right about--」

name: Soltia
message: 「What are you doing against small fry like that」

name: Azel
message: 「It's the Demon Lord... I was hit by... magical interference...」

name: Soltia
message: 「No way! Are you telling me you broke through my barrier!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Overconfidence will only lead to your ruin」
The hilt of Alzard settles firmly into Macaron's hand.
Light blooms once again in Macaron's eyes, which had been starting to cloud over.

name: Soltia
message: 「Tch... To think someone from the Nive Clan would stick their nose in...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Would you kindly refrain from throwing that name around?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Then should I call you a witch instead...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, that applies to both of us, does it not?」

name: Soltia
message: 「We can't afford to take any more magical interference and have the power inside you thrown into chaos」

name: Soltia
message: 「I'm more than enough on my own for the likes of them」

name: Melilot
message: 「However... underestimating our strength was an uncharacteristic miscalculation on your part」

name: Soltia
message: 「A newly awakened Demon Lord and a single wounded companion...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Even with a witch added to the mix, what on earth do you think you can accomplish?」

name: Synn
message: 「We won't lose to someone like you. We can't afford to lose!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Do you possess anything that surpasses this spirit... this conviction?」
